author: GoPro
description:
Wingsuit World Champion Espen Fadnes @ESPNF  takes flight above Åndalsnes, Norway, with one target in mind: Trollstigen Road, a winding mountain road with only 10% grade, where fellow wingsuit pilot and world-record holder Amber Forte @amber_forte is out for a casual bike ride.

Exiting from an elevation of over 5,000 feet, Espen accelerates across the valley, reaching speeds of 113 MPH before flying past Amber on the road below. Captured in stunning 8K on our 360 camera, GoPro MAX2.
